patch.summary: monday.com implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement monday.com by mapping current project-management workflows to monday.com objects, confirming plan gates for time tracking (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise), AI assistance (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: time tracking (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Slack

blocks.heading: monday.com day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat monday.com setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for task boards, timeline / Gantt, workload and resources before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Teams standardising on one Work OS for projects, ops and cross-functional work before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Slack and Microsoft Teams before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover time tracking (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats
Do not expand seats until task boards is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: AI credits are bundled/paid extras that raise effective TCO beyond the seat floor

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Free plan caps seats (2) and boards (3)

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Time tracking and some advanced views are Pro-gated

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: monday.com plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free

lines.label: Basic

blocks.title: Validate project-management fit before a deep monday.com rollout
blocks.body: If monday.com fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft monday.com object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on task boards
If blocked, evaluate Hive before sunk-cost expansion
